scope: standalone synthetic architecture experiment; no app/provider qualification
runtime: one current-thread Tokio 1.54.1 main runtime; async owner awaits maintained library APIs; no block_on per operation
trace: 5ms deterministic ticks; 500/2000 base events/s round-robin across streams; heavy adds ten workspace0 events per tick in first500ms of each5s; arrival timestamp is scheduled tick instant, not enqueue time
payload: id%100: 0=>64KiB bounded tool; 1..=9=>2KiB; 10=>16KiB; other=>256B; deterministic ASCII byte65+id%26

admission.selection: workspace round robin; urgent checked before each event group

read_load.cycle: recent keyset page, older keyset page, shared-context snapshot, local draft/inbox
read_load.keyset: explicit stream and seq<cursor; ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT64; materialize <=256KiB using cumulative byte bound
read_load.trace: exactly600 scheduled requests per reader, absolute start+k*50ms, k determines query/stream; serial catch-up, no skipped requests; report scheduled-to-completion and execution latency

checkpoints: PASSIVE samples every2s on writer between groups; tuple busy/log/checkpointed retained; final TRUNCATE with latency and sizes; no pinned-reader claim
focused_mechanisms: before and after cohort: dropped reply retains permit until physical work; rejected work absent; drain close; rollback-mode real COMMIT BUSY then same-transaction retry; consistent context and continuation transaction; native private NOFOLLOW alias probe

budgets.database_lifetime: fresh private database per run; removed after evidence/hash capture

engines: separate exact pinned bundled engine cohorts; report sourceid/options per result; do not attribute engine differences to driver
